suggestion.title: New jutsu icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the director-approved starter jutsu icon set.

New icon: a shield of interlocking ember-hot plates wreathed in fire, matching a blazing technique that hardens the user's body so they take less damage. It replaces the old small scene of a posing ninja, which was hard to read at small sizes.
